verdict.rationale: Factory documents Bring Your Own Machine, which lets you register your own VPS, workstation, or on-prem Linux/macOS/Windows server as a Droid Computer, and a Droid SDK that runs the same agent harness from your own code. That puts agent execution on infrastructure you control. Nothing in the evidence shows the core platform itself (App, sessions, Missions, Software Factory) can be deployed and run independently of Factory's hosted service, so this is self-hosted compute rather than a self-hosted product. Missing for 10: a documented self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the Factory platform/control plane, air-gapped or offline operation, deployment and installation docs for the server side, and independent corroboration.
